text: Mimolette is a washed-curd pressed cheese coloured with annatto and shaped into a ball; during a long cave ripening the rind is colonised by cheese mites and regularly brushed and turned, giving a dry, hard, pitted crust. Long ageing concentrates its aroma and hardens the paste.

steps.note: Up to 0.35 mL per litre, for the orange colour.
Into a sphere flattened at the poles, 2–4 kg.
Turned and brushed; vieille ripens 13 mo or more, extra-vieille 18.
